title: PMSM Field-Oriented Control
text: Permanent magnet synchronous machine field-oriented control, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {Winding Type} controls parameterization, {Control Mode} controls mode strategy, {Nominal dc-link voltage (V)} sets the rated DC voltage, {Maximum power (W)}, {Maximum torque (N*m)}, {Number of rotor pole pairs} sets the pole pairs, {Inverter dc-link voltage threshold (V)} sets the dC-link voltage threshold, {Fundamental sample time (s)} sets the block sample time 5e-6, {Control sample time (s)} controls sample time 1e-4, {Control Type} controls type strategy, {Controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain of PI controller, {Controller integral gain} sets the integral gain of PI controller, {P controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain of P controller, {Integral anti-windup gain} sets the anti-windup gain, {Current references} sets the current reference strategy Zero d-axis, {Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)} sets the rotor speed lookup vector, {Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)} sets the torque reference lookup vector, {DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)} sets the dC-link voltage lookup vector, {D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference d-axis current values zeros, {Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference q-axis current values zeros, {Modulation factor}, {Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)} sets the pM Flux Linkage, {D-axis inductance (H)} sets the inductance of d-axis, {Q-axis inductance (H)} sets the inductance of q-axis, {Stator resistance (Ohm)} sets the resistance of stator, {D-axis current proportional gain} sets the d-axis proportional gain, {D-axis current integral gain} sets the d-axis integral gain, {D-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the d-axis anti-windup gain, {Q-axis current proportional gain} sets the q-axis proportional gain, {Q-axis current integral gain} sets the q-axis integral gain, {Q-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the q-axis anti-windup gain, {Axis prioritization}, {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero cancellation, {Enable pre-control voltage} sets the precontrol voltage, {Machine parameters} sets the machine parameterization Constant, {D-axis inductance for feed-forward pre-control (H)} sets the feedforward d-axis inductance, {Q-axis inductance for feed-forward pre-control (H)} sets the feedforward q-axis inductance, {Permanent magnet flux linkage for feed-forward pre-control (H)} sets the feedforward flux linkage, {D-axis current vector, id (A)} sets the d-axis current breakpoint vector, {Q-axis current vector, iq (A)} sets the q-axis current breakpoint vector, {Ld matrix, Ld(id,iq) (H)} sets the d-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 *, {Lq matrix, Lq(id,iq) (H)} sets the q-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 *, {Permanent magnet flux linkage matrix, PM(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the flux linkage lookup data 0.04 * ones, {PWM method} sets the pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector and {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate. Values come from the instance.
